title: Digitally assisted bimaxillary complete arch implant rehabilitation using stackable surgical guides, immediate loading, and segmented prostheses: A clinical report
html: This clinical report describes a digitally assisted protocol for bimaxillary complete arch implant rehabilitation with stackable surgical guides, immediate loading, and segmented implant-supported prostheses in a 70-year-old edentulous man. The prosthetically driven digital workflow was based on a double-scan protocol for virtual planning. Eight maxillary and 7 mandibular implants were placed, with the immediate loading of all but 1 implant. After 6 months, definitive segmented restorations were delivered using posterior monolithic zirconia prostheses and an anterior zirconia framework with individual lithium disilicate crowns.
